body:
## Pull request overview

Adds a consistent Home dashboard shell and improves navigation so users can access account actions on `/home` and return to Home from within an app context.

**Changes:**
- Introduces a new `HomeLayout` wrapper with a sticky top nav, Settings button, and user menu dropdown.
- Simplifies `HomePage` by removing its duplicate header and adjusting layout spacing.
- Adds a “Home” entry to the AppSidebar app switcher dropdown to navigate back to `/home`, and adds unit tests for `HomeLayout`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks HomeLayout, home user menu, and return-to-home navigation as completed roadmap items. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the new Home user menu, HomeLayout shell, and return-to-home navigation under “Added”. |
| apps/console/src/pages/home/index.ts | Exports the new `HomeLayout` from the home pages barrel. |
| apps/console/src/pages/home/HomePage.tsx | Removes embedded header and unused import; adjusts loading/empty state and content spacing for layout wrapping. |
| apps/console/src/pages/home/HomeLayout.tsx | Adds the new Home dashboard layout shell with header branding, settings navigation, and user menu. |
| apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx | Adds a “Home” dropdown item in the app switcher to navigate to `/home`. |
| apps/console/src/App.tsx | Wraps the `/home` route’s `HomePage` with lazy-loaded `HomeLayout`. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/HomeLayout.test.tsx | Adds unit tests validating basic `HomeLayout` rendering and top-bar navigation. |
</details>

`Profile` menu item navigates to `/profile`, but the console route for the profile page appears to be `/system/profile` (see `apps/console/src/App.tsx` where `ProfilePage` is routed under `/system/*`). As-is, this click will lead to a 404/blank route. Update the navigation target to the correct profile route used by the app.

`HomePage` was updated to use `flex-1` in its loading/empty states, but `HomeLayout`'s root container is not a flex column and children are rendered without a flex wrapper. This means `flex-1` won’t expand to fill the viewport below the sticky header, so loading/empty content may not center/size as intended. Consider making the root `flex min-h-screen flex-col` and rendering `children` inside a `<main className="flex-1">…</main>` (or similar).

The tests currently avoid asserting dropdown contents/actions, so the most important behaviors introduced by `HomeLayout` (Profile navigation target, Settings item, and Sign Out calling `signOut`) aren’t covered and regressions like an incorrect route won’t be caught. Consider mocking `DropdownMenu*` components to render inline (similar to `apps/console/src/__tests__/AppHeader.test.tsx`) or otherwise rendering the Radix portal in tests, then clicking the menu items and asserting `mockNavigate`/`mockSignOut` calls.
